about: Parag L. Amin established the Law Office of Parag L. Amin, P.C., fueled by a profound belief in entrepreneurship as a cornerstone of the American dream. Based in West Los Angeles, he serves clients across these locations, providing adept legal support in areas encompassing:

His formative years were influenced by his father's journey – an immigrant from India who ventured to the United States for a better life. When his father's business faced unforeseen legal liabilities, the lack of effective legal guidance led to its eventual closure and loss of his investment. This experience deeply impacted Mr. Amin, becoming the driving force behi nd his d ecision to become a lawyer and committing himself to shielding others from business injustices that could shatter family legacies.

As a litigator and trial attorney, Parag has successfully saved and recovered over $280M for his clients. He has represented public figures, small business owners, and individuals in a variety of matters. His work has led to features in the media including ABC, CBS, Fox, NBC and KTLA, as well as quotes in publications such as the L.A. Times, L.A. Weekly, and Rolling Stone Magazine. For 2026, he i s once again being recognized with the prestigious Rising Star designation by Super Lawyers — marking his tenth consecutive year (2017–2026) receiving this honor. The Rising Star award is based on peer evaluations, which means it is based on ratings and recognition by fellow lawyers, and it is awarded to only 2.5% of attorneys who have exhibited excellence in practice . He has also been recognized as a Legal Visionary by the L.A. Times , a Top Attorney in Southern California by L.A. Magazine , and a Leader of Influence in Litigation and Trial Law by the L.A. Business Journal .

Beyond his legal prowess, Mr. Amin boasts a diverse professional background spanning real estate investment, management consulting and financial advising – experiences that have bestowed him with a distinctive financial skill set. He employs this acumen to offer a comprehensive perspective on clients' legal concerns, crafting solutions that align with their goals, financial implications and success probabilities.

Even with the awards, settlements, and successes inside and outside of the courtroom, Parag has never lost touch with the human component of what it means to be a lawyer. It is the ability to help others and give back that he finds most fulfilling.

Parag takes pride in his Indian heritage and has served clients who are based out of state and sometimes out of country ( e.g. India) and who seek an Indian lawyer in California or Los Angeles who can speak Gujarati and/or Hindi.

Parag earned his Juris Doctor degree from the University of Southern California’s Gould School of Law, which he attended on a partial academic scholarship. Parag earned his Bachelor of Science degree in Finance from the University of Maryland, College Park.
